summary: Registered + baked the v8 cerebral-vasculature and optic-pathway meshes from the BP3D archive we own (no downloads). (1) REGISTRATION: scripts/lib/register.mjs gained a third source dir assets-src/bp3d/raw-vasc/ plus the VASC_FILES (32 element keys / 56 distinct FJ files, the 26 PICA segments fused per side) and VASC_PARTS (name/out/FMA/role) tables taken from docs/VASC_INVENTORY.md §3/§5.1, a per-file dual-source resolver for array (fused) keys, 4 new axis-evidence checks (vasc/optic laterality, midline straddle, Willis closure, optic chain order) and a REGISTRATION.md Appendix B; `node scripts/lib/register.mjs` exits 0 with 13/13 axis checks PASS and writes 32 canonical OBJs (33,724 faces) into assets-src/bp3d/canonical/ (85 total). INVARIANCE PROOF: sha256 before/after diff (.dsh-scratch/vasc-register/obj-hash.mjs diff canonical-before.json canonical-after3.json) => before 53 / after 85, pre-existing changed 0, missing 0, added 32 — exit 0; independent size + bbox table for the 53 pre-existing OBJs is byte-size-identical (bbox-after.json). One documented, reported deviation: the registered vessel set leaves the AMENDMENT B box on the y- side (measured -97.3 au vs bound -55) because the ICA/vertebral elements carry their cervical course; this is recorded in registration-summary.json (vasculature.boundsCheck) and REGISTRATION.md §B.4 instead of being hidden, and only the canonical source keeps it — the bake crops the two trunks at y = -45 au so nothing rendered leaves the atlas box. (2) BAKE: new registry module scripts/anatomy-recipes/vasc-parts.mjs (+ lib/vasc-common.mjs, lib/vasc-budget.mjs) defines 32 parts (26 arteries/trunks + 6 optic) with measured per-part voxel steps, kind 'vessel' (optic chiasm 'context'), source 'bp3d+sculpt' and materialHint 'vasculature' (a hint the materials factory does not know yet — the vasc-render task wires it; makeAnatomyMaterial falls back to the nucleus preset so nothing can blank), baked through the CLI --part path into src/assets/anatomy/ and recorded in anatomy-manifest.json through the CLI's own generation path (never hand-written; re-verified by re-running `node scripts/build-anatomy-geometry.mjs --manifest` => MANIFEST + BUDGET PASS, exit 0). (3) BUDGETS: per-part caps hold (every artery <= 2,000 tris, max 1,828 ICA-r; every optic part <= 3,000, max 2,212), vascular layer 17,364 tris <= 40,000, optic 11,744, v8 layer 29,108 tris / 730,680 B; manifest totals 138 parts / 599,204 tris / 14,486,228 B = 13.82 MiB (<= 14 MiB) / scene 599,204 <= 800,000. VERIFIED: node .dsh-scratch/vasc-register/verify.mjs (exit 0, ALL CHECKS PASSED) re-parses all 32 committed GLB binaries and checks tris/bbox/centroid/kind/hint/source against the manifest, re-bakes every recipe in memory and proves each committed GLB is BYTE-IDENTICAL and watertight; node .dsh-scratch/vasc-register/slug-fj-table.mjs (exit 0) joins the manifest to register.mjs's tables from source text proving no silent drop; `node scripts/build-anatomy-geometry.mjs --stats` exits 0 and lists all 32 v8 parts; npm run validate exit 0 (0 errors, 1 warning), npm run check exit 0, npm run build exit 0, npm run verify:pipeline exit 0 (138/138 parts, 599,204 triangles, 0 problems). Two caveats for the orchestrator: the single validate warning is the content task's deliberately staged src/data/structures-pending/vasculature.json (documented in docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md §11.8; moving it now would raise 14 hard errors because those ids are not yet in taxonomy.json) and it clears when vasc-region-platform + integration-v8 land; and npm run verify:anatomy cannot run under the agent sandbox (spawnSync powershell EPERM at scripts/verify/anatomy-qa.mjs:294), so it is left to the orchestrator. Slug->FJ mapping and the per-part tri table: .dsh-scratch/vasc-register/slug-fj-table.md and REPORT.md.
